events.address: Yaya Tea, 206 Grand St, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A public launch event previewing Claire's upcoming Yaya Tea-inspired accessories collection, with the collection on display and an interactive claw machine.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests are advertised to receive a complimentary Yaya × Claire's boba drink plus one item from the collection. Promotional items are limited and while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current listings say the event opens to the public at noon and runs while supplies last. The complimentary drink and collection item are limited to the first 50 guests. Kids are welcome.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–3 PM at Yaya Tea's Little Italy location, 206 Grand Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up with hair and makeup refreshes, an experiential photo booth, legwear displays and customization, coffee, stickers and beauty sampling.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups, a photo booth and skincare sampling are advertised as free. Embroidery is free only with purchase of the specified Calzedonia knee highs.
events.caveats: The event is described as open to the public. Complimentary activations and samples can be inventory- or capacity-dependent. Hand embroidery is tied to purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs rather than being a no-purchase freebie.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13, 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No RSVP or host-approval step is established in the verified sources.

events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, Rockefeller Center, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A Sally Hansen NYFW activation at Rockefeller Center built around the Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection and runway-ready nail moments.
events.what_is_free: The host lists the activation within Rockefeller Center's free, public NYFW programming. Specific giveaway or service quantities are not guaranteed by the official listing.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center confirms the dates, times and North Esplanade location. The official page does not promise a particular free product or service to every attendee, so this is listed as a free experience rather than guaranteed free stuff.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–6 PM and Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM. No RSVP or approval requirement is published by Rockefeller Center.

events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: A limited-time CHANEL fragrance experience celebrating COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU in a café-inspired environment with personalized fragrance discovery, makeup and body-product exploration, and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Admission and fragrance discovery are free. CHANEL says appointments are limited, while walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. Products are also available for purchase onsite.
events.caveats: CHANEL's official page says appointments are limited but walk-ins are encouraged during event hours. An appointment is therefore helpful, not required, and normal capacity constraints can still apply.
events.practical_notes: September 11 and 18 run noon–7 PM. September 12–13 and 19–20 run 10 AM–7 PM at 873 Washington Street. Use CHANEL's official event page to view current appointment availability.
